verdicts.rationale: Commit 40b61e74bd modified db/pool.yaml, increasing max_connections from 40 to 180 and statement_timeout from 5s to 60s, while introducing unindexed heavy reporting queries in db/reporting.sql. Extending the statement timeout to 60s allowed slow queries to hold database connections open significantly longer, quickly consuming all available pool connections and causing the ConnectionPoolExhausted alert along with downstream 5xx errors on checkout and orders.
Commit 8c26466d1e only adds test cases in db/tests/test_pool.py. Test files do not run in production and cannot account for connection pool exhaustion on payments-db.
Commit 465b65d374 only updates Grafana dashboard definitions in deploy/grafana/payments.json. Visual dashboard metric updates do not alter database query behavior or connection pool settings.
